answer: Make every identity grow a single verifiable thread of sequential work: before it can earn, it must run a delay function that takes real wall-clock time to extend, one step after another, like crossing a canyon on a single narrow bridge — you cannot walk ten bridges at once. The thread is bound to the identity's key, so a walnut of fake accounts cannot share one thread; each fake needs its own months-long chain. Spinning up a thousand fakes costs a thousand sequential chains, while an honest agent pays the price once and keeps its thread alive.
